reviews.text: Amazing to work with very quick with responses and work, and if you have any issues they fix it immediately no questions asked!

The Netrex team was amazing! I admit that I am a perfectionist and probably hard to work with, but the team was very very patient with me and so supportive the whole time! They were always quick to say "I want you to be happy with your website." and "I am here to make any minor changes right away." These words gave me a sense of assurance, and I was able to trust them 100%! Thank you so much!

Working with Sherry was very easy. He is always available and ready to help. The whole process went very smoothly and though some parts of my work still remain, that is because I have to provide those details to him. On his end, he did a great job. I highly recommend.
fast. high quality super responsive
Great job exactly what I need thanks

Our freelancer was excellent to work with and help us build a site that is simple and perfect for our clients. I am looking forward to taking it online live this week and to start working with new clients. Our site is professional looking and is perfect for our needs.

Outstanding. In my 49 years of corporate work, this is one of the best experiences. I would recommend your firm and team to anyone. I will have a long-term partnership with you. Special thanks to Flaz Tariq for his level of help and support. To the rest of the team, A BIG THANK YOU!!!
Amazing customer service from netrex. Highly knowledgeable and will 100% be using them again in the future for my website. THANK YOU!

I employed Shery to help improve the SEO and GEO on my website, as it hadn’t originally been built with either in mind. I’m not particularly technical, so I can’t comment on the technical side of the work or the results just yet, as it will take time to see whether it improves my Google rankings and search traffic. What I can say is that Shery was really easy to communicate with, professional and took the time to explain what he was doing and why. He was very helpful throughout the process and made something that felt quite overwhelming much easier to understand. I’m looking forward to seeing the results over the coming months and would recommend Shery
Quick, efficient service with a clear understanding of my vision and a polished final result.
Great experience. Did a great job, communicated well throughout the process, and was very easy to work with. Everything turned out exactly as I was hoping. Highly recommend!
The team was great, easy to work with, open to ideas, and patient in explaining things to me and waiting for feedback. I will definitely work with them again.
Everything was great!! These guys really knew what I was looking for, even before i did! They designed everything, made all the revisions until it was perfect!!

The team delivered exceptional value by going above and beyond the initial website scope with complete focus and dedication. They meticulously implemented supplementary features, design refinements, and performance enhancements, ensuring high-quality execution without regressions. This additional effort resulted in a polished, highly functional, and professional-grade final product that significantly elevates the user experience.

Excellent and very fast service. They paid close attention to every detail and followed all the instructions I provided for the website. One of the best things is that you can request as many revisions as needed until everything is perfect. They are incredibly patient, and I would highly recommend them to anyone!

Highly recommend. Exceptional communication, prompt responsiveness and most of all the end result was amazing. Customer service and professional expertise was more than I expected.

I had a great experience working with this freelancer. They were very cooperative, paid close attention to details, and made sure the final result matched my expectations. Communication was smooth throughout the project, and they were professional and responsive. I appreciate the quality of the work and would definitely recommend them.
Very efficient and high quality work! Communication was very quick also!
Shery and team never disappoint us on project. We would highly recommend them.

I had an outstanding experience working with this web designer. They were professional, responsive, and truly understood the vision I had for my website. From start to finish, communication was excellent, and every detail I requested was handled quickly and professionally. The final website exceeded my expectations—it looks amazing, functions perfectly, and represents my brand exactly the way I envisioned. I highly recommend their services to anyone looking for high-quality web design and exceptional customer service.

I highly recommend Shery from NETREX. From start to finish, the service was outstanding. Communication was incredibly fast, and any changes I requested were made quickly without any hassle.

Shery was genuinely helpful throughout the entire website design process, offering great ideas and making sure everything was exactly how I wanted it. The quality of work exceeded my expectations.

I've worked with two previous web developers, and neither came close to the level of professionalism, speed, and attention to detail that Shery provided. This has been my best experience by far.

If you're looking for someone reliable, talented, and excellent value for money, look no further. I'll definitely be using NETREX again for future projects. A true gem—thank you for an amazing job!

I started the website thinking that I could do it myself - but no, and thankfully I did not spending more time on it myself! It looks no where as professional as the version Shery delivered. He is also very quick to respond the messages and was very supportive. Thank you for the help!
They were very responsive and polite. Handled things in a timely manner! Great job!
excellent!!!

We are extremely happy with the final result and highly recommend their services to anyone looking for quality website design and great customer service!
